truncation_theorem.finite_mode_reduction: Only |h|<=H weighted phases remain; coefficients have harmonic cost O(log H)=O(log log P).
truncation_theorem.mass_bound: For every strict row, total high-q reciprocal candidate mass W_int(P,k)<=2*pi(P)<2P; two endpoint sawtooth tails have absolute mass <=4P.
truncation_theorem.polylog_choice: For any target A>0 choose H=ceil((log P)^(A+2)); then the tail is O(P/log^(A+2)P), hence O(P/log^A P).
truncation_theorem.vaaler_tail_rule: With H>=1, endpoint truncation error is O(P/H) for nonnegative LPF-shell counting weights, after summing absolute weights.
